message.content: {"note_claim": "Iran allowed passage of Chinese vessels through the Strait of Hormuz (and most ships in the traffic are headed to China).", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Iran has said that only Chinese ships can pass through the Strait of Hormuz, calling it a \"gesture of thanks\" for Beijing’s support, adding that all other vessels are banned", "reason": "The page directly reports that Iran opened the strait to Chinese ships only, substantiating the claim that Iran allowed Chinese vessels passage, though it doesn't confirm the March 31 traffic was mostly China-bound."}

parsed.note_claim: Iran allowed passage of Chinese vessels through the Strait of Hormuz (and most ships in the traffic are headed to China).
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Iran has said that only Chinese ships can pass through the Strait of Hormuz, calling it a "gesture of thanks" for Beijing’s support, adding that all other vessels are banned
parsed.reason: The page directly reports that Iran opened the strait to Chinese ships only, substantiating the claim that Iran allowed Chinese vessels passage, though it doesn't confirm the March 31 traffic was mostly China-bound.
